mcqs.q: Why is the Demographic Transition Model criticised for not applying to all countries?
options: All countries follow the five stages of the DTM in order.
The ITCZ is the boundary between the Atlantic and Pacific oceans.

It was based on European industrialisation. LICs today face different conditions: imported medicine without industrialisation, cultural factors, gender inequality and globalised economies — not all follow the same path.

mcqs.q: What is the ITCZ and why does it bring rain?
options: The ITCZ is the boundary between the Atlantic and Pacific oceans.
The Intertropical Convergence Zone is where trade winds from both hemispheres converge near the equator, forcing air to rise, cool and produce heavy convectional rainfall.
The ITCZ is a fixed band of permanent storms at the equator.
